title: Disable Power Throttling
name: disable-power-throttling
modal: This stops Windows from slowing down your CPU and apps in the background to save power.
description: Stops Windows from throttling CPU and background apps for stable gaming clocks
deepDescription:
Windows Power Throttling slows background work to save energy, but it also causes clock dips in games. This turns it off system-wide:

- PowerThrottlingOff → On

Laptops will use more battery.
